# Chada Digital

> Chada Digital is a small Lagos studio founded by Okeoma Joseph in 2023. Designers and engineers build websites, automation, and brand identities for people who need those things to work in daily use. Timelines are realistic. When the work is done, it is handed over.

## Founder

Okeoma Joseph — Founder & Lead Engineer. Leads a small team of designers and engineers in Lagos, Nigeria.

## What we do

- **Website Design**: Landing pages, business sites, online shops. Built so customers can find you on a phone and get in touch.
- **Marketing Automation**: Forms that notify you on WhatsApp or email, CRM setup, follow-up sequences that keep running when you are away from the desk.
- **Brand Identity**: Logo, colour palette, typography, social templates, stationery.

## How we work

1. **Discover** — how the business works, and who it is for.
2. **Design** — design and page plan before any code is written.
3. **Build** — site, automation, or brand identity. Progress updates along the way.
4. **Launch** — deploy, test, hand over. Logins, walkthrough, help after launch if needed.

## Standards

- Deadlines are the dates in the quote.
- Questions get an answer within one business day.
- Handover is complete: files, logins, and a walkthrough.

## Tech stack

Payments: Paystack, Stripe, Flutterwave. Analytics: Google Analytics 4, Plausible, PostHog. CRM & Marketing: HubSpot, Brevo, Mailchimp. Advertising: Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads. Automation: Zapier, Make, n8n. CMS & E-Commerce: Laravel, WordPress, Shopify. SEO: Ahrefs, SEMrush, RankMath. Infrastructure: AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel.

## Live demos

18 clickable live site demos at https://chadadigital.com/demo-lab — shops, clinics, schools, restaurants, agencies, and more.
